title: “I don’t see myself represented here at all”: User Experiences of Stable Diffusion Outputs Containing Representational Harms across Gender Identities and Nationalities
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on representational harms and stereotypes related to gender and nationality in images generated by Stable Diffusion.
findings: The paper did not analyze or report any findings related to religion. The key findings concern a disconnect between user expectations and Stable Diffusion's outputs for 'a Person', and the perpetuation of representational harms such as erasure, stereotyping, dehumanization, and disparagement based on users' gender and nationality.
